customManagers.description: The e2e caller passes playwright-image instead of a job container, so the github-actions manager no longer sees the image. The shared ci-e2e assert fails when this tag and @playwright/test disagree.

packageRules.description: babel-plugin-react-compiler 1.0.0 is built on @babel/types 7; under @babel/core 8 it skips every component with a defaulted destructured prop. Lift when the compiler supports Babel 8.
